Historical net result resets. Cash, debt, roster, employees, courses, equipment, properties, sponsorships, fame and followers are lost. Rebuilding starts with $900 and no debt. New club: {club}.

One legacy is added, with capital and fame under the existing rules. New club: {club}. The previous career is not retained in this career: roster, assets, debts, courses, equipment, employees, sponsorships, followers, record, Hall of Fame and competitive archive reset. This cannot be undone.
